# Blockwise network construction

This archived report documents the blockwise form of the
`run_network_construction()` programmatic API. Advanced users should call that
function directly from R code.

## Construct the network

The prepared expression matrix, selected power, and network type are loaded
from the step-1 and step-2 artifacts. `tom_type = "auto"` selects a signed TOM
for signed networks and an unsigned TOM for unsigned networks.

```{r}
network_report <- run_network_construction(
  session_dir = session_dir,
  method = "blockwise",
  max_block_size = 20000,
  tom_type = "auto",
  correlation_type = "pearson",
  merge_cut_height = 0.30,
  deep_split = 2,
  min_module_size = 30,
  random_seed = 42,
  kmeans_refinement = TRUE
)

network_report
```

## Module counts

```{r}
network_report$module_counts
```

The standardized network is stored in `out/3_networks.rds`. A legacy
`out/3_networks.Rdata` containing `net` and `net_km` is also retained.
